description: The declared corpus set. The runner asserts the directories it discovers against this list, so a corpus landed without a manifest — or a manifest landed without being declared — is a failure rather than an absence the runner reports as clean. Discovery alone cannot detect what was never added.
planned_note: Specified in CORPUS-v1-PLAN.md §2 and §3. A planned corpus that does not yet exist is expected and passes; a planned corpus that EXISTS must carry an EXPECTATIONS.json and move to `built`. NOT built as of batch N1B: all three are under-determined by what is committed — the state-pipeline items assert O0 tool behaviour against a snapshot-document schema that does not exist, and the remaining bytes-platform and instruments items assert byte re-derivation, detector behaviour, or N3 coverage-report semantics, none of which the runner's schema-validation contract can express. DETERMINACY-REPORT.md is the single home of the item-by-item classification, its falsification case and the counts; this note deliberately does not restate them, because an enumeration copied here is a second home that drifts (ADR-0018 §3; ADR-0029 decision 3's rationale) — and in this batch's first draft it did drift, naming a set of half-built items that matched neither the report's headline nor its table. The schema-expressible halves that WERE built are carried in evidence-capture-v1 and labelled there by class on each case.
